correctness.rationale: The exact source update simplifies to a continuous two-branch affine map on [0,1]. Its slopes are 1/2 and (1-alpha)/(1+alpha lambda); their modulus gives a strict contraction iff alpha<2/(1-lambda). At equality the capped branch is a reflection of a fully invariant nonzero interval. Above threshold explicit branch-switch inequalities certify F(x_-)=x_+, F(x_+)=x_- and multiplier q/2. Exact-fraction script verifies independent sample substitutions; finite samples are not used to prove the quantified statement. At |q/2|=1 only neutral linear stability is claimed.

value.rationale: The method has a motivated composite-optimization safeguard; the exact threshold determines when a constant cap guarantees convergence even in its simplest strongly convex regularized instance, while critical continuum and a finite-size, locally attracting nonoptimal orbit show a qualitative failure mechanism. This is nontrivial structure absent for the same unregularized quadratic and supplies a precise caution for parameter selection, not a routine isolated example.
